subagent.label: Subagent
subagent.description: Launch an isolated Pi subagent in the background. Results arrive automatically; do not poll. The user can open it inside the main tab.

agent.description: Agent profile to launch (worker, scout, researcher, or a custom profile).

name.description: Unique display name and persistent follow-up handle.

cwd.description: Working directory; relative paths resolve from the parent cwd.

subagent_message.label: Message Subagent
subagent_message.description: Send a message to a live subagent, or resume a finished subagent's saved session with its original profile and tools.

subagents_list.label: List Subagents
subagents_list.description: List available profiles and spawned agents. Not needed to poll for results.

ask_question.label: Ask Parent
ask_question.description: Ask the parent agent a question when you need a decision. After calling, stop your turn and wait for its reply.
